name: Open Character Training
recommended_use: Persona persistence / preference method to adapt
implementation: Official pipeline: constitution-based DPO, then introspective SFT
data_format: Official DPO: chosen/rejected full message lists. Introspection: messages list.
our_adaptation: Use a dated, source-backed delegation brief; create evidence-grounded preferred/rejected continuations
caveat: Our simpler SFT→DPO baseline is an adaptation, not the paper order. data.py filters at 1024 tokens; review for long resolutions. Generic introspection is not diplomatic knowledge.

name: RoleLLM / RoleBench

our_adaptation: Replace fictional scripts with national statements; generated QA must carry supporting source spans
caveat: Use the construction idea; do not treat fictional character text as national policy or assume all HF subsets share a schema.
